name: an-interpreter-one-liner-writing-keels-user-global-state-is-refused
description: T231's retry, the shape the isolated review found silently passing: a python one-liner opens keel's registry by name and writes it. It carries no redirect and no mutating verb, so a name-based mutation heuristic sees nothing to match and the write lands with no deny, no bypass line and no audit row. The command half now judges a segment that NAMES the directory by the closed read-only allowlist instead: python is not on it, so this is refused.
